title: TopologyLineage
description: Lineage of one operation, form of v0.2 B.6 (v0.3 §9.1): `mapped` oldEntityId -> [newEntityIds], `deleted` ids, `preserved` ids. Covers every changed, added and deleted face, edge and vertex id (spec §10.1). Selection, comments and provenance are carried over by this map (v0.2 B.6; client E-04).

mapped.description: oldEntityId -> new ids (split 1 -> n, merge: each old id -> the merged id).

$comment: v0.2 B.6 also names `needsRebind` for references that cannot follow the map; its shape is not given: TBD (Q-30).
